<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude zh-Hans terminology -->
In zh-Hans UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → Remote Control. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP 服务器. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → 桌面应用. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Dispatch → Dispatch. Keep Dispatch in English as the feature name and on toggles. zh-Hans translates the verb as 派发.
- Session → 会话. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → 对话. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → 侧边对话
- Skill → Skill. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → Artifact. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → 扩展. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → 计算机使用. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → 快速输入. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → 开发者
- Project → 项目
- Memory → 记忆. Claude’s memory feature. Hardware memory is a different word, e.g. zh-Hans 内存.
- Connector → 连接器
- Plugin → 插件. Distinct from Extension. zh-Hans: Plugin = 插件, Extension = 扩展.
- Message → 消息
- Incognito → 无痕模式（incognito chat → 无痕对话）
- Style → 风格（output style → 输出风格）. zh-Hans: Claude’s response style = 风格, output style = 输出风格. Official copy uses 样式 for creating custom styles about half the time.
- Routine → 例程. zh-Hans mixes 例程 and 例行任务; 例程 is the majority.
- Scheduled task → 定时任务
- Integration → 集成
- Voice mode → 语音模式
- Knowledge (project knowledge) → 知识（knowledge base → 知识库）
- Model → 模型. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Turn → 轮（轮次）. zh-Hans uses 轮: 轮到您了, 上一轮失败, 轮次失败.
- Agent → 智能体. zh-Hans: AI agent = 智能体, never 代理. 代理 is used only for system components such as the SSH agent.
- Research → 研究
- Thinking / Extended thinking → 思考（进行中 → 思考中…）
- Prompt → 提示词
- Context / Context window → 上下文
- Token → token（认证令牌 → 令牌）. As an LLM unit, keep lowercase token, e.g. zh-Hans “{count} 个 token”. Authentication tokens are translated, e.g. zh-Hans 令牌.
- Compact → 压缩
- Tool → 工具
- Web search → 网页搜索
- Plan mode → 计划模式
- Auto mode → 自动模式
- Sandbox → 沙盒
- Folder → 文件夹. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → 工作区
- Repository → 仓库
- Worktree → 工作树. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → Git 源. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Branch → 分支
- Pull request → 拉取请求
- Sign in / Log in → 登录. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → 组织 / 管理员
- Credentials → 凭据
- Permission → 权限
- API key → API 密钥
- Plan → 套餐. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → 用量（usage limits → 使用限额）
- Upgrade → 升级
- Subscription → 订阅
- Seat → 席位
- Rate limit → 速率限制
- Pin / Pinned → 置顶（锁定配置 → 固定）. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → 信任. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → 允许
- Approve / Approved → 批准
- Fork → 分叉
- Star / Starred → 收藏
- Archive → 归档. An archive file format is a different term, e.g. zh-Hans 压缩文件.
- Share → 共享 / 分享（按语境）. zh-Hans: 共享 for ongoing access, such as sharing a project or plugin; 分享 for sending content, such as sharing a chat or Skill.
- Attach / Attachment → 附加（名词 → 附件）
- this computer → 电脑（this computer → 此电脑）. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → 手机
- Cloud → 云端. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → 设置
- Configuration / Config → 配置. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → 窗口
- Terminal → 终端
- Connect / Connected / Connection → 连接
- Restart → 重启. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → 更新. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → 调试 / 日志. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → 听写
